dct_description_sm: Contained within the 3rd Edition (1957) of the Atlas of Canada is a map that shows twenty-two condensed maps of the principal stages by which Canada evolved into a Federal State of ten provinces and two territories. The timeline of these maps ranges from 1763, when, as per the Treaty of Paris, most of northeastern North America became British to 1949, when Newfoundland became the tenth province. Each map is accompanied by a short descriptive text.
